rationale: Do not preserve Southern Power as a separate APG portfolio company. Southern Power is a wholly owned Southern Company subsidiary, while APG acquired a 33% limited-partner interest in the distinct renewable-asset partnership operated and controlled by Southern Power. Southern Power's SEC filings identify that partnership as SP Solar Holdings I, LP. The repository already contains a separate published record for that portfolio under the display name Southern Power solar portfolio. That record, its immutable queue task, and its production company ID are therefore the canonical keep path. This parent-level task is superseded without a database or seed mutation; the immediately following canonical task will correct the keep record to the legal partnership identity, preserve the Southern Power operating relationship, verify APG's 33% ownership through Scarlet Renewables LLC, and separately retire the erroneous APG-attributed parent record without treating the two legally distinct companies as aliases. Treating the parent as an APG-owned PortCo would overstate APG's investment perimeter and contradict both APG's announcement and Southern Power's filings.

identityResolution.platformBoundary: The in-scope PortCo is the limited partnership that indirectly owns substantially all of Southern Power's solar and battery storage facilities, not Southern Power Company or its broader conventional and renewable generation business.
identityResolution.recommendedCanonicalTreatment: Keep the existing solar-portfolio company record and correct it to SP Solar Holdings I, LP with Southern Power solar and storage portfolio as an alias. Remove the erroneous APG attribution from the separate Southern Power record and retire it from the PortCo list without a canonical identity redirect because Southern Power Company and SP Solar Holdings I, LP are legally distinct.

ownershipResolution.southernPowerRole: Majority owner, general partner through wholly owned subsidiaries, and operating controller
ownershipResolution.currentStatus: Southern Company's June 30, 2026 filing continued to report SP Solar as 67% owned by Southern Power with cash distributions allocated 67% to Southern Power and 33% to the limited partner. APG Asset Management US's March 25, 2026 Form ADV continued to list Scarlet Renewables LLC as an APG-managed private fund.
ownershipResolution.exitSearch: No APG sale, transfer, or pending exit was identified through August 8, 2026. The current Southern Company filing preserves the same 67%/33% partnership economics, and APG's current regulatory filing continues to identify the original 33% buyer vehicle as APG-managed.
